Kevin Mancini received his B.S. degree in Computer Engineering from the Alma Mater Studiorum – University of Bologna, Italy, in 2018, and his M.S. degree in Computer Science from Imperial College London, United Kingdom, in 2024, where he was awarded the ”Splunk Prize for Excellence in MSc Individual Project” for the best individual project in data science and machine learning within the department. 
He is currently pursuing an M.S. degree in Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics at Sapienza University, Rome, Italy. 
His research focuses on machine learning and deep learning on graphs.
